scope: Compare already-completed independent grid-frame and primary converter-dq-frame implementations; do not import either solver into the other
alignment: Select every fourth independent sample after verifying each timestamp matches the primary timestamp within 1e-12 seconds; no waveform interpolation
event_handling: Both outputs must be right-continuous at 0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8 seconds: preserve continuous state and use the post-event reference for algebraic power/voltage
reference_gate: Reference vectors must agree exactly on matched samples and at every event
power_tolerance_reason: Same absolute cross-solver gate as the independently frozen verification protocol; declared before paired output differences are computed
auxiliary_metrics: Report controller-frame id/iq, delta, voltage magnitude and filter-state differences; the formal response acceptance gate is power plus time/reference consistency
sources: Record immutable bytes/hash of each input NPZ, numeric-array hashes, both protocol hashes, original generating-code hash from manifests, and current primary-code hash separately
failure_policy: Record failure without loosening the gate; diagnose timestamp/reference convention before attributing any numerical difference to the model
